sourceQuery.rawQuery:
SELECT
COUNT(DISTINCT BE.`Instance Id`) AS TotalAssets,

COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN BE.AssetLifecycleStatus IN (
        'Ordered',
        'Received',
        'Being Assembled',
        'Reserved'
    )
    THEN BE.`Instance Id`
END) AS ProcurementPreparation,

COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN BE.AssetLifecycleStatus = 'In Inventory'
    THEN BE.`Instance Id`
END) AS InventoryReadiness,

COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN BE.AssetLifecycleStatus IN (
        'Deployed',
        'On Loan',
        'Transferred'
    )
    THEN BE.`Instance Id`
END) AS ActiveService,

COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN BE.AssetLifecycleStatus IN (
        'In Repair',
        'Down'
    )
    THEN BE.`Instance Id`
END) AS MaintenanceRecovery,

COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN BE.AssetLifecycleStatus = 'End of Life'
    THEN BE.`Instance Id`
END) AS RetirementPlanning,

COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN BE.AssetLifecycleStatus IN (
        'Disposed',
        'Return To Vendor',
        'Delete'
    )
    THEN BE.`Instance Id`
END) AS RetiredDisposed

FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE
LEFT OUTER JOIN `AST:AssetPeople` AP
    ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = AP.`AssetInstanceId`

WHERE
    (${ShowEverything:singlequote} = 'True' OR 
        (AP.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio))
        AND (${Relationship:singlequote} = 'All Relationships' OR AP.PersonRole = $Relationship)
    )
    AND BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
    AND BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
    AND (
        BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No'
        OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL
    )

SELECT
    BE.`Name` AS AssetName,
    BE.`Short Description` AS AssetDescription,
    BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` AS AssetType,
    BE.`Class Id` AS Class,
    BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AS Instance,
    BE.`Serial Number` AS SerialNumber,
    BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` AS AssetLifecycleStatus,

    CASE
        WHEN BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` IN (
            'Ordered',
            'Received',
            'Being Assembled',
            'Reserved'
        ) THEN 'Procurement_Preparation'

        WHEN BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = 'In Inventory'
        THEN 'Inventory_Readiness'

        WHEN BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` IN (
            'Deployed',
            'On Loan',
            'Transferred'
        ) THEN 'Active_Service'

        WHEN BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` IN (
            'In Repair',
            'Down'
        ) THEN 'Maintenance_Recovery'

        WHEN BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = 'End of Life'
        THEN 'Retirement_Planning'

        WHEN BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` IN (
            'Disposed',
            'Return To Vendor',
            'Delete'
        ) THEN 'Retired_Disposed'

        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS LifecycleBucket,

    BE.`Model Number` AS Product,
    BE.`MarketVersion` AS Version,
    AP.PersonRole,
    AP.`Full Name`

FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE

INNER JOIN `AST:AssetPeople` AP
    ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = AP.`AssetInstanceId`

WHERE
     (${ShowEverything:singlequote} = 'True' OR AP.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio))
    AND  (${Relationship:singlequote} = 'All Relationships' OR  AP.`PersonRole` = $Relationship)
    AND BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
    AND BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
    AND (
        BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL
        OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No'
    )

GROUP BY
    BE.`Name`,
    BE.`Short Description`,
    BE.`UserDisplayObjectName`,
    BE.`Class Id`,
    BE.`Reconciliation Identity`,
    BE.`Serial Number`,
    BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus`,
    CASE
        WHEN BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` IN (
            'Ordered',
            'Received',
            'Being Assembled',
            'Reserved'
        ) THEN 'Procurement_Preparation'
        WHEN BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = 'In Inventory'
        THEN 'Inventory_Readiness'
        WHEN BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` IN (
            'Deployed',
            'On Loan',
            'Transferred'
        ) THEN 'Active_Service'
        WHEN BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` IN (
            'In Repair',
            'Down'
        ) THEN 'Maintenance_Recovery'
        WHEN BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = 'End of Life'
        THEN 'Retirement_Planning'
        WHEN BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` IN (
            'Disposed',
            'Return To Vendor',
            'Delete'
        ) THEN 'Retired_Disposed'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END,
    BE.`Model Number`,
    BE.`MarketVersion`,
    AP.PersonRole,
    AP.`Full Name`

panels.description: Assets outside active service requiring monitoring or lifecycle action

sourceQuery.rawQuery:
SELECT
CASE
    WHEN BE.AssetLifecycleStatus IN (
        'Ordered',
        'Received',
        'Being Assembled',
        'Reserved'
    ) THEN 'Procurement and Preparation'
    WHEN BE.AssetLifecycleStatus = 'In Inventory'
    THEN 'Inventory Readiness'
    WHEN BE.AssetLifecycleStatus IN (
        'In Repair',
        'Down'
    ) THEN 'Maintenance and Recovery'
    WHEN BE.AssetLifecycleStatus = 'End Of Life'
    THEN 'Retirement Planning'
    WHEN BE.AssetLifecycleStatus IN (
        'Disposed',
        'Return To Vendor',
        'Delete'
    ) THEN 'Retired and Disposed'
END AS LifecycleCategory,
COUNT(DISTINCT BE.`Instance Id`) AS AssetCount
FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE
LEFT OUTER JOIN `AST:AssetPeople` AP
    ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = AP.`AssetInstanceId`
WHERE
    (
        ${ShowEverything:singlequote} = 'True'
        OR (
            AP.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio)
            AND (
                ${Relationship:singlequote} = 'All Relationships'
                OR AP.PersonRole = $Relationship
            )
        )
    )
    AND BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
    AND BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
    AND (
        BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No'
        OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL
    )
    AND BE.AssetLifecycleStatus IN (
        'Ordered',
        'Received',
        'Being Assembled',
        'Reserved',
        'In Inventory',
        'In Repair',
        'Down',
        'End Of Life',
        'Disposed',
        'Return To Vendor',
        'Delete'
    )
GROUP BY
CASE
    WHEN BE.AssetLifecycleStatus IN (
        'Ordered',
        'Received',
        'Being Assembled',
        'Reserved'
    ) THEN 'Procurement and Preparation'
    WHEN BE.AssetLifecycleStatus = 'In Inventory'
    THEN 'Inventory Readiness'
    WHEN BE.AssetLifecycleStatus IN (
        'In Repair',
        'Down'
    ) THEN 'Maintenance and Recovery'
    WHEN BE.AssetLifecycleStatus = 'End Of Life'
    THEN 'Retirement Planning'
    WHEN BE.AssetLifecycleStatus IN (
        'Disposed',
        'Return To Vendor',
        'Delete'
    ) THEN 'Retired and Disposed'
END
